package.name: armv7_impedance_moveit
package.description: 6-DoF Cartesian impedance / admittance controllers for the armv7 arm. v0.2 alpha ships a working Cartesian impedance controller (KDL-based, reuses the v0.1 gravity + friction calibration from armv7_zero_force_controller). The eventual target is a screw-driving primitive that drives one axis under monitored normal force while keeping the other 5 DoFs compliant — that high-level node is a separate package and consumes this controller.
package.author: TianFeiF
